usage: agentware skill validate [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--name NAME]
                                [--source SOURCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --name NAME           validate only this skill (default: all)
  --source SOURCE       validate an IN-PLACE authored skill DIR directly (runs
                        vet_skill_dir; no catalog entry needed)
